title: Reference search: one box, words and meaning together, on the References page
description: Phase 1 (Ryan approved 2026-11-02). One search box on the newsroom References page runs keyword and semantic search together and returns normal Reference cards, rated or not, so an editor can find a Reference again. Backend: searchReferences query on the knowledgeQuery Lambda (in-memory inverted index over title, authors, source URL, externalItemId, filled incrementally from listReferencesByVersionStateAndUpdatedAt; query_by_vector over reference_summary vectors; Reciprocal Rank Fusion; opaque cursor). Frontend: box above Sort and Show, ?q= in the URL, Relevance sort label, Matched: labels. CLI: papyrus references search. Not in scope: rejected vectors, S3 cached index, body-word search, top-bar search, /newsroom/search.
